title: Bedrock Pattern Finder
description: A fast, client-side Fabric utility mod that calculates absolute world coordinates by matching bedrock floor patterns using modern 1.18+ generation math.
body:
# Bedrock Pattern Finder

**Bedrock Pattern Finder** is a powerful client-side Fabric utility mod for Minecraft 1.21+ that allows you to calculate absolute world coordinates by matching the bedrock floor pattern. 

Perfect for finding specific locations, verifying seeds, or recovering coordinates when you only have access to the bedrock floor layout!

## 🌟 Features

*   **Modern Generation Support:** Fully supports the modern Minecraft (1.18+) bedrock generation algorithm. It accurately computes bedrock at `Y=-60` using the game's native `RandomSplitter` math.
*   **Intuitive GUI:** A clean, easy-to-use 16x16 interactive grid. Simply click the squares to draw the bedrock blocks you see in front of you. 
*   **Lightning Fast & Multithreaded:** Uses advanced multithreading to scan thousands of chunks in the background. Your game could lag while a search is running if the Chunk Range is high for example 1000 Chunks!
*   **Smart & Persistent UI:** Your typed seed and search radius are automatically saved when you close the menu. No need to type them again!
*   **Client-Side Only:** This mod runs entirely on your client. It works perfectly on multiplayer servers as long as you know the world seed.

## 🛠️ How to Use

1. **Open the GUI:** Type `/bedrockfind` or `/bedrockfind gui` in the game chat.
2. **Enter the Seed:** Type the world seed in the "Seed" field.
3. **Set the Range:** Define how many chunks around your current position the mod should scan (e.g., `100` chunks).
4. **Draw the Pattern:** Look down at the bedrock floor (`Y=-60`) and click the cells in the grid to match the bedrock blocks you see.
    * ⬛ **Black (Empty):** Ignored block (Wildcard - can be anything).
    * ⬜ **Gray:** Bedrock block.
5. **Search:** Click "Search Coordinates". The mod will scan the area in the background and output all matching coordinates and rotations directly into your chat!

## 📦 Installation

This is a **Fabric** mod. You will need:
*   [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/) installed for Minecraft 1.21.11.
*   [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) (Recommended)

Simply drop the downloaded `.jar` file into your `mods` folder and launch the game.
